audience: teams that collect responses through Formcrafts forms

useCases.title: See recent form responses
useCases.text: List the forms of the organization, then list the responses of one form, filtered by date with the before and after parameters.

useCases.title: Find unfinished form responses
useCases.text: Get one form, then list its partial responses. These are the answers that were started but not finished.

useCases.title: Review the fields of a form
useCases.text: Get one form with its pages, fields, required flags and response count.

useCases.title: Read a text file uploaded through a form
useCases.text: List the files uploaded through forms, then read the content of a text file, up to 200 KB.
